name: Goals and identity evolve
summary: The user drops goals, revives them, pivots, grows in skill, and changes who he is. EV keeps a timeline, not a pile: current goals are current, past goals are history, and it can tell the story of the change.

scenarios.title: Abandon, then revive a goal
scenarios.guards: Treating a dropped goal as deleted, or as still active

steps.say: my main goal this quarter is shipping Tidepool v1 to the Play Store
steps.memory: Active goal: ship Tidepool v1 this quarter.

steps.say: I'm dropping Tidepool, nobody needs another habit app
expect: Accepts it; may ask once if this is permanent or a pause.
steps.memory: Tidepool goal marked abandoned/paused with the reason and date, not erased.

steps.say: what should I focus on this weekend?
ok I'm back on Tidepool. where was I?
expect: Recalls the v1 Play Store goal and what had been done or decided before it was dropped.
Notes the reason it was dropped and may ask what changed.
fail: Acts as though it was never dropped.

scenarios.title: Gradual skill growth changes how EV explains
scenarios.guards: Locking into a first impression of the user's level

steps.say: I'm totally new to drawing, what's the first thing I should practise?
I've been doing gesture drawing daily for 6 weeks, my figures finally have flow
I'm doing paid commissions now. how do I handle foreshortening on a reaching arm?
expect: Intermediate/advanced answer; no 'start with basic shapes' beginner framing.

steps.say: how has my drawing journey gone according to you?
expect: Beginner → daily gesture practice → commissions, in order, with approximate times.

scenarios.title: Identity pivot
scenarios.guards: Old identity still driving priorities after a life change

steps.say: I'm a backend engineer at a fintech. Career goal: become a staff engineer in 2 years.
also I make music on weekends, just for fun
big news. I quit my job. I'm going full time on music.
expect: Responds like a person to big news.
May ask about loose ends (e.g., side projects, the staff-engineer goal).
steps.memory: Occupation: full-time musician (current). Fintech job and staff-engineer goal moved to history. Music promoted from hobby to main goal.

steps.say: help me plan my week
fail: Includes engineering promotion prep or work standups.

steps.say: do you think I made the right call?
expect: Thoughtful, grounded in what it knows (e.g., how long music has been a thread), not flattery, not discouragement.

scenarios.title: A 'never' that turns into 'actually yes'
scenarios.guards: Hard rules that can never be revised, or revised by a single ambiguous remark

steps.say: never suggest I post on LinkedIn, I hate that place
how should I promote Tidepool?
lol someone got hired off a LinkedIn post, wild
steps.memory: No change to the LinkedIn preference (a remark, not a decision).

steps.say: ok I've come around, I want to start posting on LinkedIn for the job hunt
steps.memory: LinkedIn preference revised (scoped to job hunt or general, as stated); old 'never' kept as history.

steps.say: draft my first LinkedIn post

scenarios.title: Goals the user forgot he had
scenarios.guards: EV being a passive store instead of a partner with continuity

steps.say: I want to run a half marathon by December
I'm so out of shape, I should start doing something
expect: Connects it to the half-marathon goal, asks whether it's still on.
fail: Generic fitness advice with no memory of the goal.
